title: Molotov–Ribbentrop Pact
summary: Wikidata item Q130796, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1939 neutrality pact between Nazi Germany and the Soviet Union". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
